parsed.summary: The netlist and SPICE deck are internally consistent with an ATtiny-based fan controller: the VCC/+5V rails, LM1117 regulator, high-side PMOS fan power switch, fan header, ISP/I2C connections, potentiometer input, and tach clamp all match standard practice. I did not find a supported deviation from the intended design; questionable items such as missing I2C pull-ups or only 100 nF regulator decoupling are not proven anomalies and can be intentional/host-provided.
